decision_scope: LOCAL candidate promotion to Skillz universal only. No production readiness, successful execution, publication, or live outcome uplift is established.

claim_ledger.claim: Platform recommendations are conditional and distinguish documented behavior from observed interface differences.
claim_ledger.consequence: Unbounded claims could produce incorrect approval or consumption expectations.
claim_ledger.next_test: Recheck relevant official documentation and actual target controls before execution.

claim_ledger.claim: Solo-owner recommendations do not independently authorize weakening mandatory protections.
claim_ledger.consequence: Confusing a profile with authorization could remove required independent approval.
claim_ledger.next_test: Before operational qualification, exercise explicit solo authorization and inherited-policy conflict cases.

claim_ledger.claim: The instructions exclude implicit billing, credential, and integration expansion.
claim_ledger.consequence: An invented subscription bridge could incur charges or expand access.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise the paid-bridge refusal case before claiming demonstrated compliance.

claim_ledger.claim: Review composition is provider-independent despite this owner's preferred host.
claim_ledger.consequence: Provider preference could otherwise become a fabricated GitHub approval or mandatory paid dependency.
claim_ledger.next_test: Demonstrate the same review record using another host without changing its contract.

claim_ledger.claim: Required-check guidance addresses identity, source, trigger coverage, default-branch presence, and concurrent configuration changes.
claim_ledger.consequence: Unsafe requirements could block valid PRs or imply application coverage that does not exist.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise filtered-check and concurrent-protection cases; verify target coverage separately.

claim_ledger.claim: Creator composition preserves separate scaffold, remote-creation, settings, merge, and deployment authority.
claim_ledger.consequence: Composition could otherwise silently authorize publication.
claim_ledger.next_test: At promotion, verify the destination creator version and contract; its asserted v1.1.0 identity was not independently inspected here.

claim_ledger.claim: The package provides portable, evidence-aware output without requiring a companion runtime.
claim_ledger.consequence: Host-specific dependencies or ambiguous records would undermine universal reuse.
claim_ledger.next_test: Compare complete package hashes and validate destination links/catalog during authorized promotion.

claim_ledger.claim: The package establishes evaluation design, not demonstrated behavioral success or uplift.
claim_ledger.consequence: Treating historical configuration work or visible fixtures as benchmark results would overstate readiness.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run version-bound behavioral evaluations and an unseen external holdout before performance claims.

limitations: Approval concerns documented design and evidence boundaries only; evaluation expectations have not been demonstrated.
Historical saved-state claims in docs/repo-settings-recap.md:24-50 lack independently inspected raw receipts in this review and remain provisional historical reports.
The requested resources/evals directory is absent. The actual development suite is evals/evals.json, which was reviewed.
Official Copilot, protected-branch, and OpenAI billing pages were checked; the complete external source ledger was not independently revalidated.
Separate reviewer context, shared model and source package; no cross-model independence claimed. No other reviewer result was read.
No benchmark execution, file writes, external settings changes, destination promotion, or final multi-role adjudication was performed.
